title: Aakhri Chitthi - Bansi Kaka Ki Dak

Original-language lines and kinship terms (Kaka, Maa, Chacha, Munna) stay intact, and nothing from the resolution is shown.

hook.text: Six years I've delivered letters to that house. Not one ever came from you.
